summary: Central money for a new electric scooter in 2026 is smaller than headline city figures, and it ends 2026-12-31 with no 2027 round announced. The Ministry of Economic Affairs pays NT$7,000 for 普通重型第1、2級 and 普通輕型第1級 scooters, but only NT$5,100 for 普通輕型第2級 and 小型輕型 ones, so check your model's class. Add NT$3,000 for Taiwan-made battery cells and NT$1,000 if you scrap a gasoline scooter 10 or more years old: up to NT$11,000. The environment ministry adds one payment of NT$1,000-2,200 for scrapping, chosen on its platform before you buy. Whether its carbon and air payments can both be claimed is not settled, so count only one. Gasoline buyers get no scrapping subsidy, only a goods-tax refund of NT$2,000 (new) or about NT$4,000 (scrapping a 4+ year old scooter); electric is already goods-tax exempt to 2030. A 125cc gasoline scooter pays no licence tax, so the electric exemption saves nothing against it. The fuel fee is about NT$450 a year for 51-125cc; electric is exempt for now but charging is expected from 2030. City top-ups decide whether price parity is reachable.

findings.subject: MOEA new-purchase electric scooter: 普通重型第1、2級 and 普通輕型第1級

findings.conditions: New purchase; model on 受認可電動機車/補助車款 list; no scrapping needed; not a gasoline benefit.
findings.status2027: unknown: no 116 programme found; 要點 amended 114-12-23, funds to 115-12-31
findings.verifierNote: Rendered the official PDF (115/07/21) as an image: the 7,000 column header is 普通重型第1、2級 + 普通輕型第1級. The earlier finding wrongly put 普通輕型第2級 in the 7,000 group. Portal page (updated 115/10/07) and PDF both opened.

findings.subject: Reconciling NT$6,000 / ~2,800 / 3,300 for MOENV scrap money
findings.valueText: 今周刊 (2026-01) gives 環境部 約 $2,800 = 空污 1,000 + 碳權 1,500 + 回收金 300 (elsewhere in same article $2,300-2,800). TVBS (2025-07-28) says air subsidy cannot be claimed together with carbon reward. 6,000 unsupported.
findings.quote: 環境部：汰舊換新獎勵 約 $2,800 包含空污獎勵 $1000、碳權 $1500、回收金 $300 | TVBS: 同上（不可與減碳獎勵金併領）
findings.conditions: Official PDF does not say whether carbon and air streams can both be claimed. Conservative calculator rule: count only ONE MOENV stream (best available: 2,200 regional air, 2,100 TSMC carbon, or 1,000 nationwide air) until the MOENV platform confirms stacking. 300 recycling fee is a scrap-yard payment, not a subsidy.

findings.subject: Which central items stack
findings.valueText: MOEA 7,000 or 5,100 + 3,000 cell bonus + 1,000 scrap bonus are listed together. MOENV: pick ONE buyer within carbon and ONE within air; whether carbon and air can both be claimed is unresolved. Goods-tax and licence-tax exemptions are automatic.

Pre-purchase platform choice required per city bureaus (SECONDARY).
findings.verifierNote: Earlier note had a garbled sum. Corrected to explicit arithmetic and a one-MOENV-stream conservative rule; TVBS 2025 says carbon and air cannot be combined, 今周刊 sums both.
